diagnostics.message: :module.cur_per_service: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_service is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:module.cur_per_resource_process: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource_process is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:module.cur_per_resource: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.cur_per_resource has `depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource]`, but the module already references that resource implicitly through `logging_log_group = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource.name`. The depends_on adds no ordering that the attribute reference doesn't already create, so it can be dropped.

module.cur_per_resource_process has `depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource_process]`, but the module already references that resource implicitly through `logging_log_group = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_resource_process.name`. The explicit depends_on duplicates an edge Terraform already infers and can be removed.

module.cur_per_service has `depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_service]`, but the module already references that resource implicitly through `logging_log_group = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.cur_per_service.name`. The explicit depends_on duplicates an existing implicit dependency and can be removed.

aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource delivers its export to the billing bucket, and the BCM Data Exports service validates the destination bucket's resource policy when the export is created (s3:PutObject and s3:GetBucketPolicy for bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com — the statement declared as EnableAWSDataExportsToWriteToS3AndCheckPolicy). The export only depends on aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, so on a fresh apply it can be created before aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy exists and the API call fails. Add an explicit depends_on (no attribute of aws_s3_bucket_policy can be substituted for s3_bucket).

aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_service delivers its export to the billing bucket, and the BCM Data Exports service validates the destination bucket's resource policy when the export is created (s3:PutObject and s3:GetBucketPolicy for bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com). The export only depends on aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, so it can be created before aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy and fail on a fresh apply. Add an explicit depends_on (aws_s3_bucket_policy exposes no attribute usable for the s3_bucket argument).
